'''Rogue 2''' is a [[persona]]: every card that represents this vehicle counts as the same vehicle, whatever its title, and each player may have only one card of a persona on the table at a time.<ref name="ar2023">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf Players Committee Advanced Rulebook] (2023), Chapter 5, Personas, and Appendix D, Persona Lists. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192915/https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The 3 card pages of the Rogue 2 persona fall under 2 card titles, listed below in release order (Decipher cards first, then the Players Committee's Virtual cards).
